title: Qwen speech takes the right route
summary:
Qwen speech routing and Nova Reel inputs got attention, while the dashboard and app credits received a quieter tidy-up.

The simple audio endpoint now routes `qwen-tts` and `qwen-tts-instruct` to the Qwen handler instead of ElevenLabs. It also accepts an `instruct` query parameter for `qwen-tts-instruct`; Qwen TTS responses are WAV regardless of `response_format`.

Nova Reel requests support durations up to 120 seconds in multiples of six. The gateway now prepares reference images for the model and returns more useful errors for invalid prompts, unsupported image-and-duration combinations, and provider capacity limits. ElevenLabs speech and elevenmusic metadata was also marked alpha.

Non-actionable labels across keys, models, pricing, tiers, and usage now use rectangular tags. The sidebar also gained Terms, Privacy, and Refunds links, alongside a smaller logo.

highlights.title: Longer Nova Reel clips
highlights.text: Request Nova Reel videos up to 120 seconds long, in multiples of six seconds. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nova-reel).

highlights.title: Instruct Qwen speech
highlights.text: Use the `instruct` query parameter with `qwen-tts-instruct` on `/audio/{text}` to guide speech generation. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
